svg.title: A4 + A5 + A6 / DISPATCH AND THE UPPER RETURN

g.text: A4 + A5 + A6 / DISPATCH AND THE UPPER RETURN
BUILT A-01 / BLOCKOUT 05 / Freight card before the split / Watch Gallery +6 m leads down through Clearance
The lobby feeds into Dispatch past K.
A partition separates the exit vestibule from
the lobby, so it is reached through Dispatch.
The ordinary route leaves toward A5.
Maintenance keeps its existing ladder and gate;
A5 has no connection across to that upper tunnel.
G1: two 2 m flights, +2 to +6 m.
O1: three 2 m flights, +6 to 0 m.
Both stairs are reversible; no floor-level bypass.
Rails guard the open edges and stair landings.
SECTION / the longer return becomes a sustained upper route
